purpose: design how data is structured, stored, protected and evolved so it stays correct and performs as the system grows
entry_criteria: Domain model and requirements for data are known
Volume, access patterns and consistency needs are estimated
Compliance requirements for data are known
procedure: Choose the data store type from access patterns and consistency needs, and record the alternatives considered.
Design schemas with explicit keys, constraints and relationships; define ownership of each dataset.
Plan indexes from the main queries and estimate size and growth.
Design for evolution: how schema changes are made without downtime and how data is migrated.
Define protection: encryption, access roles, masking of sensitive fields, retention and deletion.
Review with the engineers who will use it and record decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Each dataset has an owner and constraints

validation.check: run the top five queries on a production-sized sample with EXPLAIN
check each sensitive field against the protection rules

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Orders use a relational store because of transactional consistency. The design defines the order and line tables with foreign keys, an index on customer and date, and a rule to archive orders after seven years.
